title: Continuous Vibrations for level alerts
body:
Hello every one. I am using the setup of a blueReader, Sony Xperia XZ1 and a Sasung Gear S3. 
xdrip+: 73cfa6d-2018.07.09

I would be nice, to have an option for l(evel) alerts, only having vibration but this continuously for a certain time. My reason is, that I go on hiking trips with night stays in small huts and shared rooms. Even better would be a vibrating watch.

Thanks a lot and great work!

comments.body: As far as I know it pretty much does this already. Pebble and Wear will vibrate quite a bit on alerts and you can set your phone to silent and the watches will still vibrate. Phone alarms also can have vibrate as an option.

Setting the alerts to vibration does half of the job. In this case my phone vibrates 3 times but not more. The vibration stops without any action by me. My workaround is to set the reoccurrence to the lowest limit of one minute.

My watch does not vibrate in any case.

I would like to confirm that continuous vibration alarm would be an important feature!
Vibrating only 3 times is insufficient for an alarm.

I take it you feel that constant vibration will eventually wake you up without waking up the other people sleeping in the same room.

Would you please explain why the ascending alarm profile would not accomplish the same objective?
It starts the alarm at extremely low volume.  Every minute, it repeats the alarm at a slightly higher volume level.  The volume is gradually increased.

Closing due to inactivity
Please update (answer questions) before reopening.
